AttributeList.Text: Keyed local-retain config. The typed owner validates before publishing a value.

LineComment.Text: Parse a bounded decimal grammar ourselves. Native string conversion
accepts prefixes and can overflow before a post-conversion check.
Grammar/overflow are checked before the platform conversion. It owns
the final IEEE rounding; repeated decimal arithmetic is not a codec.
The rounded native value must also satisfy the declared limits.
